note: Approved index §2 example: intrinsic Volume and a custom float parameter animated after @sound in the same body.
markup: <Button Content="Confirm"><Button.Resources><SoundClip Name="ConfirmSound">Source = "audio/confirm.wav"; Volume = 0.8; @parameter ToneCutoff: float = 1200; @parameter EchoMix: float = 0.15; @modifier LowPass { Cutoff = ToneCutoff; } @modifier Delay { Time = 120ms; Feedback = 0.20; Mix = EchoMix; }</SoundClip></Button.Resources><Button.Aspect>@handle Playback; @on Click { @sound $ConfirmSound(Volume = 0.2, ToneCutoff = 800) as Playback; @animate with Tween(300ms, EaseOut) { @to { $self.sound.Playback.Volume = 0.8; $self.sound.Playback.ToneCutoff = 6000; } } }</Button.Aspect></Button>

note: @from snapshot, current destination and a Spring spec.
markup: <Button Content="x"><Button.Resources><SoundClip Name="Tone">Source = "audio/tone.wav";</SoundClip></Button.Resources><Button.Aspect>@handle Playback; @on Click { @sound $Tone as Playback; @animate with Spring(520, 38, 1) { @from { $self.sound.Playback.Volume = 0; } @to { $self.sound.Playback.Volume = 1; } } } @on MouseEnter { @animate { @to { $self.sound.Playback.Volume = current; } } }</Button.Aspect></Button>

note: One parameter feeds two modifier inputs; the animated value lies in their intersected range 0–0.95.
markup: <Button Content="x"><Button.Resources><SoundClip Name="Wash">Source = "audio/wash.wav"; @parameter Amount: float = 0.3; @modifier Delay { Feedback = Amount; Mix = Amount; }</SoundClip></Button.Resources><Button.Aspect>@handle Playback; @on Click { @sound $Wash as Playback; @animate { @to { $self.sound.Playback.Amount = 0.9; } } }</Button.Aspect></Button>

note: A handle plays two clips; the parameter both declare is animatable within the intersection of their ranges.
markup: <Button Content="x"><Button.Resources><SoundClip Name="A">Source = "audio/a.wav"; @parameter Cut: float = 900; @modifier LowPass { Cutoff = Cut; }</SoundClip><SoundClip Name="B">Source = "audio/b.wav"; @parameter Cut: float = 300; @parameter Extra: float = 0.1; @modifier LowPass { Cutoff = Cut; } @modifier Delay { Mix = Extra; }</SoundClip></Button.Resources><Button.Aspect>@handle Playback; @on Click { @sound $A as Playback; @animate { @to { $self.sound.Playback.Cut = 4000; } } } @on MouseEnter { @sound $B as Playback; }</Button.Aspect></Button>

note: Keyframes and an audio-only @sequence started through the Sound session.
markup: <Button Content="x"><Button.Resources><SoundClip Name="Tone">Source = "audio/tone.wav"; @parameter Cut: float = 900; @modifier LowPass { Cutoff = Cut; }</SoundClip></Button.Resources><Button.Aspect>@handle Playback; @on Click { @sound $Tone as Playback; @sequence { @keyframes duration 400ms { @animate 0%..100% { @from { $self.sound.Playback.Volume = 0; } @to { $self.sound.Playback.Volume = 1; } } } @animate { @to { $self.sound.Playback.Cut = 200; } } } }</Button.Aspect></Button>

note: Audio Motion in @when/@if bodies rides the Sound sidecar of the reactive rule.
markup: <Button Content="x"><Button.Resources><SoundClip Name="Tone">Source = "audio/tone.wav";</SoundClip></Button.Resources><Button.Aspect>@handle Playback; @when $self.Opacity { @if value > 0.5 { @sound $Tone as Playback; @animate { @to { $self.sound.Playback.Volume = 0.3; } } } @if value < 0.5 { @animate { @to { $self.sound.Playback.Volume = 0; } } } }</Button.Aspect></Button>

<Button Content="x"><Button.Resources><SoundClip Name="Tone">Source = "audio/tone.wav";</SoundClip></Button.Resources><Button.Aspect>@handle Playback; @on Click { @sound $Tone as Playback; @animate { @to { $self.sound.Missing.Volume = 0.3; } } }</Button.Aspect></Button>

expect.message: 'Missing' is not a Sound handle of this Aspect

note: Declared but never started by @sound: no clip, so no audio identity to animate.
markup: <Button Content="x"><Button.Resources><SoundClip Name="Tone">Source = "audio/tone.wav";</SoundClip></Button.Resources><Button.Aspect>@handle Playback; @handle Idle; @on Click { @sound $Tone as Playback; @animate { @to { $self.sound.Idle.Volume = 0.3; } } }</Button.Aspect></Button>

expect.message: 'Idle' is not a Sound handle of this Aspect

markup: <Button Content="x"><Button.Resources><SoundClip Name="Tone">Source = "audio/tone.wav";</SoundClip><MotionClip Name="Pulse" TargetType="Button">@animate { @to { Opacity = 0.5; } }</MotionClip></Button.Resources><Button.Aspect>@handle Playback; @handle Visual; @on Click { @sound $Tone as Playback; @run $Pulse as Visual; } @on MouseEnter { @animate { @to { $self.sound.Visual.Volume = 0.3; } } }</Button.Aspect></Button>

expect.message: 'Visual' is not a Sound handle of this Aspect

markup: <Button Content="x"><Button.Resources><SoundClip Name="Tone">Source = "audio/tone.wav";</SoundClip></Button.Resources><Button.Aspect>@handle Playback; @on Click { @sound $Tone as Playback; @animate { @to { $self.sound.Playback.Cutoff = 300; } } }</Button.Aspect></Button>

expect.message: Sound handle 'Playback' has no animatable parameter 'Cutoff'

note: A .sound. path never falls back to a property of the element.
markup: <Button Content="x"><Button.Resources><SoundClip Name="Tone">Source = "audio/tone.wav";</SoundClip></Button.Resources><Button.Aspect>@handle Playback; @on Click { @sound $Tone as Playback; @animate { @to { $self.sound.Playback.Opacity = 0.5; } } }</Button.Aspect></Button>

expect.message: Sound handle 'Playback' has no animatable parameter 'Opacity'

note: Loop, Source and Position are not Motion targets.
markup: <Button Content="x"><Button.Resources><SoundClip Name="Tone">Source = "audio/tone.wav";</SoundClip></Button.Resources><Button.Aspect>@handle Playback; @on Click { @sound $Tone as Playback; @animate { @to { $self.sound.Playback.Loop = 1; } } }</Button.Aspect></Button>

expect.message: Sound handle 'Playback' has no animatable parameter 'Loop'

note: Cut is missing from one clip the handle can play.
markup: <Button Content="x"><Button.Resources><SoundClip Name="A">Source = "audio/a.wav"; @parameter Cut: float = 900; @modifier LowPass { Cutoff = Cut; }</SoundClip><SoundClip Name="B">Source = "audio/b.wav";</SoundClip></Button.Resources><Button.Aspect>@handle Playback; @on Click { @sound $A as Playback; @animate { @to { $self.sound.Playback.Cut = 4000; } } } @on MouseEnter { @sound $B as Playback; }</Button.Aspect></Button>

expect.message: Sound handle 'Playback' has no animatable parameter 'Cut'

markup: <Button Content="x"><Button.Resources><SoundClip Name="Tone">Source = "audio/tone.wav";</SoundClip></Button.Resources><Button.Aspect>@handle Playback; @on Click { @sound $Tone as Playback; @animate { @to { $self.sound.Playback.Volume = loud; } } }</Button.Aspect></Button>

expect.message: Sound Motion value 'loud' for 'Playback.Volume' must be current or a number within 0–1

markup: <Button Content="x"><Button.Resources><SoundClip Name="Tone">Source = "audio/tone.wav";</SoundClip></Button.Resources><Button.Aspect>@handle Playback; @on Click { @sound $Tone as Playback; @animate { @from { $self.sound.Playback.Volume = 0; } @to { $self.sound.Playback.Volume = 1.5; } } }</Button.Aspect></Button>

expect.message: Sound Motion value '1.5' for 'Playback.Volume' must be current or a number within 0–1

markup: <Button Content="x"><Button.Resources><SoundClip Name="Tone">Source = "audio/tone.wav"; @parameter Cut: float = 900; @modifier LowPass { Cutoff = Cut; }</SoundClip></Button.Resources><Button.Aspect>@handle Playback; @on Click { @sound $Tone as Playback; @animate { @to { $self.sound.Playback.Cut = 5; } } }</Button.Aspect></Button>

expect.message: Sound Motion value '5' for 'Playback.Cut' must be current or a number within 20–20000

note: Bindings are not approved audio Motion values.

note: Audio and element targets keep separate lifecycles, so one execution cannot animate both.
markup: <Button Content="x"><Button.Resources><SoundClip Name="Tone">Source = "audio/tone.wav";</SoundClip></Button.Resources><Button.Aspect>@handle Playback; @on Click { @sound $Tone as Playback; @animate { @to { $self.sound.Playback.Volume = 0.3; Opacity = 0.5; } } }</Button.Aspect></Button>

expect.message: A Motion execution cannot mix Sound targets with element, Prism or MotionClip targets
